parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch lever of the electrical switch, made of ABS plastic. It is the part that users press or toggle to turn the circuit on or off.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as the actuator that completes or breaks the electrical connection when pressed or toggled.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly or pivots slightly when pressed, returning to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the switch, made of polycarbonate. It houses the internal electrical contacts and supports the switch lever.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and insulation for the internal components, ensuring safe operation and mounting stability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
